messages.text: Can you make a OR with these changes ?
I’m taking “OR” to mean a pull request. I’ll package the analysis scripts, figures and validation results into a reviewable PR.

I found the nODD repository and confirmed that the unrooted setup is merged. I’m preparing a separate branch with portable scripts, figures and compact profile data; the large scan and generated ROOT files will stay outside Git.

The figures now regenerate from compact profile data, so reviewers won’t need the 698 MB scan. I’m using the repository’s nODD validation workflow for a separate check of the normalization, sensitivity labels and uncertainties, while rerunning the portable classifier on the full scan.

The portable classifier reproduced the full scan with all 17.1 million steps accounted for and no density mismatches. The separate review has confirmed the zero-inclusive normalization and total-error calculation so far. I’m finishing the provenance record and repository checks before opening the PR.

The review found one small edge case in the reusable precision correction. It doesn’t affect this scan; I’ve corrected it and added a passing regression check. I’m running the corrected version once more before pushing the PR.

Created [PR #99](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/99). It includes the figures, compact profile data, portable scripts and separate validation reports. I’m adding its required interaction record and checking the CI status.
Update the token usage of this PR, make sure the discussions are recorded and go on.

I’ll recover the completed-turn usage for PR #99, refresh its public discussions and record the available user and agent messages. I’ll keep active-turn usage separate until it can be measured reliably, then finish the PR checks.
